firstBattleIntro: Enemies ahead. Before we fight, let's decide where I should stand.
firstBattleDeploy: Drag my portrait onto the glowing tile.
firstBattleStart: That position will do. Let's begin the battle.
firstBattleAp: Every action costs AP. Party AP is shared by everyone, and I can use up to 4 of it per turn.
firstBattleMove: Moving costs AP too. The number on each tile is the cost. Let's step forward one tile.
firstBattleSkill: Frost Bolt reaches 2 to 3 tiles away. It can't hit anything too close, so be careful.
firstBattleAim: Choose a target. The number above its head is the damage you will deal.
firstBattleEndTurn: There's no AP left for an attack. Let's end the turn.
firstBattleEnemyPhase: It's the enemy's turn. Watch how they move.
firstBattleThreat: Select an enemy to see the tiles its attacks can reach.
firstBattleOutro: Frost Bolt can't reach an enemy right next to me. Use a normal attack for that. ...The rest is up to you.
